spec_family.name: Exterior Foundation Wall Repaint (Combined Assessment + Prep + Prime + Finish)
spec_family.description: Combined condition assessment + prep + prime + finish repaint spec for previously painted above-grade foundation walls (poured concrete and CMU). Covers 4-point condition assessment (visual, chalk/adhesion, moisture MC <= 4% HARD STOP, grade-line gap check for incorrect caulking), efflorescence treatment, pressure wash (1,500-2,500 PSI), scraping/feathering failing paint, crack patching, state-driven primer (chalk-binding for SS_EXT_CHALKING, alkali-resistant spot prime on exposed bare masonry pH 12-14, acrylic stain-block for general RP adhesion), finish coat application (acrylic or cementitious — brush_roll primary, spray_backroll for larger runs). SF-based with ITM_FOUNDATION_WALL. 2 foundation types (poured/CMU). QT2-QT3 only (utilitarian — QT4/QT5 excluded). Flat sheen only. Ground-level access only — no height modifier. CRITICAL: NEVER caulk the 3/8-inch siding-to-foundation grade-line gap — it is an intentional drainage plane. Simplest exterior RP spec — 28 tasks, 6 modules, 2 modifiers, max stack 1.84x. No RRP (foundation coating is modern practice). No block filler (NC-only). NC sibling: SF_FOUNDATION_EXT_NC_v1.

includes: 4-point condition assessment (visual, chalk/adhesion, moisture, grade-line gap)
Moisture testing (MC <= 4% HARD STOP — stricter than masonry wall 12%)
Grade-line gap assessment for incorrect previous caulking (RP-specific)
Pressure wash (1,500-2,500 PSI — dual purpose: cleaning + paint removal)
Scraping and feather-edge sanding of failing/peeling paint
State-driven primer: chalk-binding (SS_EXT_CHALKING), alkali-resistant spot (exposed bare), acrylic stain-block (failing/peeling)
Finish coat application — acrylic (1-2 coats by QT) or cementitious/Drylok-type (1-2 coats by QT)
Final inspection, touch-up, and site cleanup

excludes.route_to: NC scope only — already applied at new construction
Lead specialist — foundation coating is modern practice, pre-1978 painted foundations extremely rare
Separate scope — flag for removal if found, but removal work is not in this spec's estimation

configuration_dimensions.notes: QT2=economy (single finish coat, light wash). QT3=standard (full wash, 2 finish coats). QT4/QT5 excluded — utilitarian surface.
4 standard exterior RP substrate states. Each drives distinct prep pathway and primer selection.
GOOD=SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT (1.0x prep). FAIR=SS_EXT_CHALKING or localized failing (1.3x). POOR=SS_EXT_PEELING or widespread failure (1.6x).
Same as NC. Drives production modifier (CMU 1.15x slower). Block filler excluded in RP.
Same as NC. Acrylic standard. Cementitious (Drylok-type) for moisture-prone areas.
brush_roll primary (small foundation areas). spray_backroll for larger continuous runs.

paintable_items.name: Exterior Above-Grade Foundation Wall Surface
paintable_items.counting_rules: Net paintable above-grade foundation wall area in square feet. Perimeter LF x band height (12-36 inches). Excludes below-grade surfaces. Measured from PaintScope.
paintable_items.notes: Reuse from NC spec. Single paintable item. foundation_type modifier adjusts rates per substrate.

valid_input_states.notes: 4 exterior RP substrate states. SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT may skip prime with verified adhesion. SS_EXT_CHALKING requires chalk-binding primer. SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT/SS_EXT_PEELING require alkali-resistant on bare + acrylic stain-block.

output_state.notes: All input states normalize to SS_EXT_PAINTED_FLAT after proper prep and coating. Foundation is flat sheen only.

material_systems_summary.name: Chalk-Binding Primer for Chalking Foundation
material_systems_summary.notes: RP-SPECIFIC. MANDATORY for chalking foundation. Full surface application.

material_systems_summary.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer for Foundation RP
material_systems_summary.notes: RP-SPECIFIC. For previously painted areas with adhesion concerns.

material_systems_summary.name: Alkali-Resistant Foundation Primer (Reuse NC)
material_systems_summary.notes: Reuse NC. MANDATORY on exposed bare foundation (pH 12-14). Spot prime in RP.

material_systems_summary.name: Standard Acrylic Foundation Coating (Reuse NC)
material_systems_summary.notes: Reuse NC. QT2=1 coat, QT3=2 coats.

material_systems_summary.name: Cementitious Coating (Drylok-type) (Reuse NC)
material_systems_summary.notes: Reuse NC. QT2=1 coat, QT3=2 coats.

module_summary.description: 4-point assessment: visual, chalk/adhesion, moisture, grade-line gap
Efflorescence treatment, pressure wash, scrape/feather, crack patch, dust cleanup
State-driven: chalk-binding, alkali-resistant spot, acrylic stain-block (roll/spray)
Finish coats — acrylic (roll/spray) or cementitious (roll/brush) + detail brush + backroll
Final inspection, touch-up, protection teardown, tool clean, site debris, customer walkthrough

round_configurations.name: Skip Prime + 1 Finish Coat (Sound Paint, QT2)
round_configurations.notes: Economy refresh on sound paint. Skip prime (verified adhesion). Single finish coat.

round_configurations.name: Skip Prime + 2 Finish Coats (Sound Paint, QT3)
round_configurations.notes: Standard refresh on sound paint. Skip prime. 2 finish coats.

round_configurations.name: State-Driven Prime + 1 Finish Coat (QT2)
round_configurations.notes: Economy RP with state-driven primer + single finish coat.

round_configurations.name: State-Driven Prime + 2 Finish Coats (QT3)
round_configurations.notes: Standard RP with state-driven primer + 2 finish coats. No interstage sanding (utilitarian surface).

variants.notes: BASELINE. Standard refresh on sound poured concrete foundation. Skip prime, 2 acrylic finish coats brush_roll.
Economy refresh on sound poured concrete. Single acrylic coat.
Standard RP on chalking poured concrete. Chalk-binding primer (full surface) + 2 acrylic finish coats.
Standard RP on failing poured concrete. Scrape/feather + alkali-resistant spot prime + acrylic stain-block prime + 2 finish coats.
Standard RP on peeling poured concrete. Heavy scrape + full prime + 2 finish coats. Most labor-intensive poured variant.
Standard refresh on sound CMU foundation. Skip prime, 2 finish coats. CMU 1.15x modifier on coating tasks.
Standard RP on failing CMU with cementitious coating. Highest material consumption variant.
Spray variant for larger foundation scope. Sound poured concrete. Fastest production.
Spray on failing CMU. Backroll required per masonry doctrine. TSK_FNRP_FINISH_BACKROLL activates.

required_paintscope_inputs.required_when: When landscape is adjacent to foundation wall
required_paintscope_inputs.description: Linear feet of foundation perimeter where landscape requires protection

When patio is adjacent to foundation wall

protection_zones_required.notes: RP includes scraping debris containment. Spray upgrades to full tarp over plantings.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Siding meets foundation at grade line with 3/8-inch gap. NEVER caulk this gap. Foundation coating terminates below siding edge.
Foundation meets grade. Rough termination at soil line is acceptable.
Water table trim (if present) at siding-to-foundation transition.

adjacency_declarations.key_finding: Foundation wall has NO edge work requirements within this spec. Same as NC.

stacking_partition.never_cross: Condition NEVER applies to coating tasks.

factor_modifiers_summary.max_stack: 1.84x (POOR condition x CMU foundation_type on prep tasks). Well under 4.0x cap.
factor_modifiers_summary.notes: Simplest modifier profile of any exterior RP spec. 2 modifiers only. No access, no RRP, no QT modifier (only 2 tiers).

compatibility_rules.description: Oil-based and alkyd products PROHIBITED on alkaline concrete/CMU foundation
compatibility_rules.notes: Inherited from NC COMPAT-FNDN-001. Saponification risk on pH 12-14 substrate.

compatibility_rules.description: Moisture content must be at or below 4% before any coating
compatibility_rules.notes: Inherited from NC COMPAT-FNDN-002. Stricter than masonry wall (12%).

compatibility_rules.description: NEVER caulk the 3/8-inch grade-line gap below siding
compatibility_rules.notes: Inherited from NC COMPAT-FNDN-003. RP adds: if previously caulked, flag for removal.

compatibility_rules.description: Alkali-resistant primer MANDATORY on exposed bare masonry
compatibility_rules.notes: pH 12-14 substrate. Spot prime in RP context.
Foundation is highly susceptible to efflorescence due to ground contact.

hard_stops.action: STOP — do not coat until foundation dries to MC < 4%
hard_stops.description: Foundation MC > 4% at coating surface will cause coating failure.
hard_stops.notes: Stricter than masonry wall (12%). Foundation has continuous ground contact.

hard_stops.action: STOP — resolve moisture source before painting
hard_stops.description: Active efflorescence indicates ongoing moisture migration. Coating will fail.
hard_stops.notes: Dormant efflorescence can be treated and painted.

hard_stops.description: Cracks > 1/4 inch with displacement indicate structural movement.
hard_stops.notes: Cosmetic hairline cracks (< 1/8 inch) are patchable.

boundaries.notes: Siding protection above foundation is siding spec responsibility.

cross_spec_coordination.notes: Foundation is an isolated low-interaction spec. No cross-spec flags needed.

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Setup -> Assess (4-point) -> Prep (efflorescence -> wash -> 24 hr dry -> scrape/feather -> patch -> dust cleanup) -> Prime (state-driven) -> Finish (1-2 coats by QT) -> Final Inspect -> Touch-up -> Teardown -> Tool clean -> Site debris -> Customer walkthrough
sequencing_notes.edge_work: No edge work in this spec. Grade-line gap provides natural siding termination. Soil line provides rough bottom edge.
sequencing_notes.key_prohibitions: NO caulking the grade-line gap. NO oil-based/alkyd products. NO coating at MC >4%. NO QT4/QT5. NO block filler in RP.

relationships.notes: Simplest exterior RP spec. NC sibling: SF_FOUNDATION_EXT_NC_v1. Key RP departures from NC: 4 substrate states (vs 1 NC state), condition scale modifier, state-driven primers, scraping/feathering, no block filler, no form-release removal, RP assessment module, customer walkthrough.

research_corrections.original_claim: Environmental conditions should be estimation modifiers
research_corrections.corrected_to: Environmental conditions are NOT estimatable — excluded from spec
RRP excluded — foundation coating is modern practice

change_log.changes: Initial spec.json assembly from 6 pipeline artifacts. QA Critic: PASS with 1 minor issue (condition scale modifiers need field calibration). 28 tasks across 6 modules, 5 material systems (2 RP-specific primers + 3 NC reuse), 5 coverage profiles, 14 consumables, 6 compatibility rules (3 critical + 2 major + 1 critical RP-specific), 2 factor modifiers (foundation_type + condition), max stack 1.84x (well under 4.0x cap), 4 round configurations, 3 protection zones, 3 adjacent surfaces, 7 PaintScope inputs, 9 variants, 1 paintable item (ITM_FOUNDATION_WALL SF-based reuse), 6 configuration dimensions, 3 hard stops. Simplest exterior RP spec. Context prefix FNRP. Combined assessment + prep + prime + finish. No RRP (modern practice). No block filler (NC-only). No access modifier (ground-level). Grade-line gap assessment is RP-specific. NC sibling: SF_FOUNDATION_EXT_NC_v1.
